rows.GENERAL RULES: If in doubt about a product: 1. Check Favourites list and put a note with the product. 2. Search in Order History. 3. Ask supplier via their preferred form of communication. Once identified, add the correct product to the Favourites list.

rows.GENERAL RULES: If a customer requests adding to a previous order, only add to an existing order when there is no Purchase Order (PO) and when the status is "Submitted".  Do not add to an existing order if the status is "Accepted", please create a new order instead

rows.SUPPLIER RULES: If there is no date on the order please put tomorrow (today if past midnight in the timezone of the country where the order is!!) but put a comment in additional notes and message the supplier. Or eg 12:30AM it's for the same day

rows.GENERAL RULES: We will be using the last 6 weeks of sales history to refresh your favourites so that these are up to date and allow the AI trainer to have the latest information when checking orders
rows.SUPPLIER RULES:
If someone orders something that you’re not sure of:
- Enter the description under “MISC” code excluding tax 
- Add the ordered product description to the additional notes
Only enter those emails received from start of shift to end of shift
Don't place an order if you can't find the customer and notify the supplier by the communication method
If there is a request for a credit don't enter it into Fresho and forward to the supplier
YES place the order if the customer is inactive.

If You Cannot Check Out Due To A Charged Card, Go To The Customer Tab, Search For The Customer'S Name, And Navigate To Payment Settings.   Then, Uncheck The Charge Card Option And Save It. Once You Have Completed The Checkout, Don'T Forget To Recheck It And Save Again.
If the customer orders a specific number without specifying the unit of order (ie. 4 Broccoli) check Order History, then check Favouries
PC = Pieces please put it in as Each
If the quantity type doesn't exist - use your best judgement and then add a supplier note with the requested quantity type
If the customer says no charge (ie. for a credit / replacement) please place the order and put this comment on the Supplier product note and in additional notes
ADDITIONAL RULES
If there's a cancel email please forwrd to orders email
Please do not process any orders for Chefgood ever.
If the orders has a purchase order it does need to be a separate invoice, it can be put together for regular email order
